story:
SETS (make each one a cast member of kind "set" and give every shot the set of the place it shows):
1. Brighton seafront: the pier and its shingle beach by the sea (kit place: beach); morning wind, afternoon, golden dusk
2. Grandfather's kitchen with a wooden table and a window (kit place: kitchen); morning light

KEY OBJECT (the owner's notes — draw it exactly so): Maya's red diamond kite: a red sail on a cross of thin bamboo sticks, a tail of small bows, flown on a string. States in order: intact (smooth taut sail) → torn (a jagged hole with a flap of sail hanging down and the sky showing through it) → patched (a white cloth patch over the hole with visible stitches) → starred (the same patch with a big gold star painted on it).

On a windy autumn morning in Brighton, eight-year-old Maya flies her red kite above the pier. A gust slams it into the pier railings, and the red sail tears from corner to corner. Maya runs home along the seafront, the broken kite hugged to her chest. Her grandfather, who mended sails when he was young, looks up from his newspaper. At the kitchen table he lays the kite flat and threads a needle with sailcloth thread. Stitch by stitch, he shows Maya how a sailor's seam holds against the wind. Maya paints a small gold star over the patch, so the kite will remember. In the afternoon they walk back to the beach together, the kite under Grandfather's arm. Maya runs into the wind, and the kite climbs higher than ever over the waves. She hands the string to her grandfather, and he laughs like a boy. At golden dusk they walk home along the sand, the mended kite on Maya's shoulder.

bible.title: The Mended Kite
bible.logline: A gust tears a child's kite; a grandfather's sailor stitch and a gold star lift it higher than ever.

cast.name: Maya
cast.look: Eight-year-old girl with short curly brown hair, wearing a yellow raincoat over a striped tee, blue jeans, red wellies. Signature detail: a small silver seashell necklace.

cast.name: Grandfather
cast.look: Elderly man with white beard, round spectacles, wearing a navy cardigan over a white shirt, brown trousers, leather slippers. Signature detail: a faded anchor tattoo on his forearm.

cast.name: Red Diamond Kite
cast.look: Red diamond kite: a red sail on a cross of thin bamboo sticks, a tail of small bows, flown on a string.

parts.look: red diamond-shaped fabric sail, taut and smooth, about twice as wide as tall, with the bamboo cross spars visible underneath
two thin bamboo sticks crossed at center — one vertical spine, one horizontal cross-spar — forming the diamond frame, ends meeting the four sail corners
long thin tail attached to bottom point, decorated with a row of small fabric bows spaced along its length
short lines at the four corners where the flying string attaches, meeting at a central tow point on the front face

cast.name: Brighton Seafront
cast.look: Wide shingle beach with a wooden pier stretching into the sea, pastel beach huts, gentle waves, morning wind blowing grasses.

cast.name: Grandfather's Kitchen
cast.look: Cozy kitchen with a wooden table by a window showing the garden, floral curtains, a kettle, a stack of newspapers.

shots.description: Wide shot of Brighton seafront on a windy autumn morning; Maya stands on the pier holding the string, her red kite soaring high above the railings under crisp morning light.
shots.dialogue: On a windy autumn morning in Brighton, eight-year-old Maya flies her red kite above the pier.

shots.description: Medium shot at the pier railings as a sudden gust slams the kite into the wood, the red sail tearing from corner to corner with a flap hanging down, morning wind still blowing.
shots.dialogue: A gust slams it into the pier railings, and the red sail tears from corner to corner.

shots.description: Low angle following Maya as she runs along the shingle beach toward home, the torn kite hugged to her chest, soft morning light on the sand.
shots.dialogue: Maya runs home along the seafront, the broken kite hugged to her chest.

shots.description: Close-up inside the kitchen at morning light; Grandfather sits at the wooden table, newspaper lowered, looking up toward the door with surprised eyes.
shots.dialogue: Her grandfather, who mended sails when he was young, looks up from his newspaper.

shots.description: Close-up on the kitchen table: Grandfather's hands lay the torn kite flat and thread a needle with sailcloth thread, morning sun filtering through the window.
shots.dialogue: At the kitchen table he lays the kite flat and threads a needle with sailcloth thread.

shots.description: Medium over-the-shoulder two-shot: Grandfather guides Maya's hands stitch by stitch, the kite on the table now patched with a white cloth and visible stitches, warm morning light.
shots.dialogue: Stitch by stitch, he shows Maya how a sailor's seam holds against the wind.

shots.description: Close-up on the kite's patch as Maya paints a small gold star over the white cloth, the star gleaming in the morning light.
shots.dialogue: Maya paints a small gold star over the patch, so the kite will remember.

shots.description: Wide shot of the seafront in bright afternoon; Grandfather and Maya walk side by side along the sand, the starred kite tucked under Grandfather's arm, golden light on the waves.
shots.dialogue: In the afternoon they walk back to the beach together, the kite under Grandfather's arm.

shots.description: Low angle from behind Maya as she runs into the wind, the kite climbing higher than ever above the rolling waves, string taut, afternoon breeze.
shots.dialogue: Maya runs into the wind, and the kite climbs higher than ever over the waves.

shots.description: Medium two-shot: Maya hands the string to Grandfather, both smiling, the kite soaring high above them in the afternoon sky.
shots.dialogue: She hands the string to her grandfather, and he laughs like a boy.

shots.description: Wide shot at golden dusk on the sand; Maya and Grandfather walk home together, the mended starred kite resting on Maya's shoulder, warm amber light stretching long shadows.
shots.dialogue: At golden dusk they walk home along the sand, the mended kite on Maya's shoulder.
